svg.title: Einstein animated companion
svg.desc: A softly shaded chibi Einstein on white. Idle by default. Use #wave, #speaking or #thinking to select a pose. Character layers and all motion are embedded; no video or external assets.
svg.metadata: {"format": "self-contained animated SVG", "motion": "CSS transform keyframes plus SMIL vector mouth", "painting": "Embedded Blender-rendered independent PNG layers, not whole-frame video", "duration": 4, "states": ["idle", "wave", "speaking", "thinking"]}
